item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on any country selling oil to Cuba, backing Mexico into a corner
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order that would impose a tariff on any goods from countries that sell or provide oil to Cuba, a move that could further cripple an island plagued by a deepening energy crisis. item.title: Alabama native named USSPACECOM transition team director
item.description: Space Command Commander Gen. Stephen Whiting has announced Alabama Native Maj. Gen. Terry L. Grisham will lead USSPACECOM's transition team as the command works to move operations to Redstone Arsenal.
